items.problem: A code-instantiated WinUI 3 Popup opened via IsOpen=true with no XamlRoot silently never renders; the Compass calibration bar migrated but never appeared.
items.evidence: migration-score.json Calibration verdict=partial (invokeOk=false); migrated CalibrationBar.xaml.cs RequestCalibration() sets CalibrationPopup.IsOpen=true without XamlRoot.
items.root_cause: Skill documented XamlRoot for ContentDialog only; Popup has the identical WinUI 3 requirement but was uncovered.
items.change: Added a WARN heuristic in Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 flagging .cs files that set Popup.IsOpen=true with no XamlRoot assignment (analogous to the existing background-task dead-control check). Tier 1 chosen because a silent no-op is invisible at build time and easy for prose to be ignored; a validator signal cannot be skipped.
items.expected_effect: Migration agent is warned to set Popup.XamlRoot before IsOpen=true, restoring popup/overlay display.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, validator emits '[WARN] Popup.IsOpen = true found with no XamlRoot' for the unfixed CalibrationBar, and Calibration requirement goes partial->pass once XamlRoot is set (banner appears).

items.problem: Same as above — documentation had no Popup+XamlRoot guidance to point the agent (and validator WARN) to.
items.evidence: grep of winui-uwp-migration for 'Popup' returned only the ContentDialog section; no Popup mention.
items.change: Added a 'Popup needs the same XamlRoot' subsection under the Dialogs pattern in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md with a code example and reuse of the existing XamlRoot-selection table. Tier 3 supplements the Tier 1 signal so the agent knows the concrete fix; the validator WARN references this anchor.
items.expected_effect: Agent sets Popup.XamlRoot when migrating code-instantiated popups/overlays.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run: migrated code that opens a Popup assigns XamlRoot; validator Popup WARN does not fire.
